points.title: 人质岁月
points.description: 腓力二世早年作为人质被送往底比斯，这段经历对他产生了深远影响。在底比斯，他接受了希腊城邦的先进军事和政治教育，特别是学习了伊巴密浓达的方阵战术和底比斯的民主制度。这段经历使他深刻理解了希腊城邦的军事弱点，同时也为他后来改革马其顿军队奠定了基础。他在底比斯学会了希腊语，熟悉了希腊文化，并结识了许多希腊政治家和军事家，这些关系在他后来的政治生涯中发挥了重要作用。
points.descriptionEn: Philip II spent his early years as a hostage in Thebes, an experience that profoundly influenced him. In Thebes, he received advanced military and political education, learning about the phalanx tactics of Epaminondas and the democratic institutions of Thebes. This period allowed him to deeply understand the military weaknesses of Greek city-states and laid the foundation for his later military reforms in Macedon. He learned Greek, became familiar with Greek culture, and established connections with Greek politicians and military leaders that would prove valuable in his later political career.

points.title: 继承王位
points.description: 腓力二世于公元前359年回到马其顿，当时他的哥哥帕迪卡斯三世在伊利里亚战争中阵亡，马其顿面临内忧外患。腓力被任命为摄政王，随后正式登上王位。他即位时，马其顿王国处于分裂状态，北方部落威胁不断，南方希腊城邦轻视马其顿为蛮族国家。腓力迅速稳定国内局势，镇压了贵族叛乱，并与北方部落达成和解。他开始进行军事改革，组建了著名的马其顿方阵，并引入了长矛兵（萨里沙长矛）和骑兵战术，为马其顿的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Philip returned to Macedon in 370 BC and became regent in 359 BC after his brother Perdiccas III was killed in the Illyrian War. He then ascended to the throne. At that time, Macedon was facing internal strife and external threats, with northern tribes threatening and southern Greek city-states viewing Macedon as a barbarian state. Philip quickly stabilized the domestic situation, suppressed noble rebellions, and made peace with northern tribes. He began military reforms, creating the famous Macedonian phalanx and introducing sarissa-wielding infantry and cavalry tactics, laying the foundation for Macedon's rise.

points.title: 军事扩张
points.description: 腓力二世在位期间进行了大规模的军事扩张。他首先征服了北方的佩奥尼亚人和伊利里亚人，消除了北方威胁。随后，他向东扩张，征服了色雷斯沿海地区，控制了通往黑海的贸易路线。他还占领了希腊北部的卡尔基迪克半岛，建立了多个殖民地。腓力二世改革了马其顿军队，创建了由贵族组成的精英骑兵伙伴骑兵（Hetairoi），并改进了方阵战术，使用长达6米的萨里沙长矛。他还建立了强大的攻城器械，使马其顿军队成为当时最强大的军事力量。这一时期的军事扩张使马其顿从小国崛起为巴尔干半岛的霸主。
points.descriptionEn: During his reign, Philip II conducted extensive military expansion. First, he conquered the Paeonians and Illyrians to the north, eliminating northern threats. Then he expanded eastward, conquering the coastal regions of Thrace and controlling trade routes to the Black Sea. He also occupied the Chalcidice peninsula in northern Greece, establishing several colonies. Philip reformed the Macedonian army, creating the elite Companion Cavalry (Hetairoi) of nobles and improving phalanx tactics with the 6-meter sarissa pike. He also developed powerful siege engines, making the Macedonian army the most formidable military force of its time. This period of military expansion transformed Macedon from a small kingdom into the dominant power in the Balkans.

points.title: 征服希腊
points.description: 腓力二世将目光投向希腊本土，开始干预希腊城邦事务。他利用希腊城邦之间的矛盾，先是第三次神圣战争（公元前356-346年）中支持底比斯对抗福基斯，随后在喀罗尼亚战役（公元前338年）中彻底击败了雅典和底比斯的联军。这场战役标志着希腊城邦独立时代的结束。腓力二世在科林斯召集了全希腊大会，建立了科林斯同盟，确立了马其顿对希腊的霸权。他计划以希腊盟主的身份领导希腊人征服波斯，但这一计划因他在公元前336年被刺杀而未能实现。腓力二世对希腊的征服不仅结束了希腊城邦的独立，也为他儿子亚历山大大帝的东征奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Philip II turned his attention to mainland Greece, beginning to intervene in the affairs of Greek city-states. He exploited the divisions among Greek city-states, first supporting Thebes against Phocis in the Third Sacred War (356-346 BC), and then decisively defeating the combined forces of Athens and Thebes at the Battle of Chaeronea (338 BC). This battle marked the end of the era of independent Greek city-states. Philip convened a pan-Hellenic congress at Corinth, establishing the Corinthian League and confirming Macedonian hegemony over Greece. He planned to lead the Greeks in an invasion of Persia as the leader of the Greek alliance, but this plan was cut short when he was assassinated in 336 BC. Philip's conquest of Greece not only ended the independence of Greek city-states but also laid the foundation for his son Alexander the Great's eastern campaigns.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 征服希腊后，腓力二世在马其顿首都佩拉和古都埃盖（今韦尔吉纳）巩固他的统治。他建立了中央集权的官僚体系，改革了马其顿的行政和财政制度。腓力二世还积极推动希腊文化与马其顿传统的融合，鼓励希腊学者和艺术家前往马其顿宫廷。他开始筹备对波斯的远征，组建了庞大的舰队和军队。然而，他的统治也面临着内部挑战，包括与奥林匹亚斯（亚历山大之母）的紧张关系，以及与多位妻子的复杂家庭关系。公元前336年，腓力二世在女儿的婚礼庆典上被保萨尼阿斯刺杀身亡，他的儿子亚历山大继位，继续他的征服事业。
points.descriptionEn: After conquering Greece, Philip II consolidated his rule in Macedon's capital Pella and the ancient capital Aigai (modern Vergina). He established a centralized bureaucratic system and reformed Macedon's administrative and financial institutions. Philip actively promoted the fusion of Greek culture and Macedonian traditions, encouraging Greek scholars and artists to come to the Macedonian court. He began preparations for the expedition against Persia, assembling a large fleet and army. However, his rule also faced internal challenges, including tensions with Olympias (Alexander's mother) and complex family relationships with his multiple wives. In 336 BC, Philip was assassinated at his daughter's wedding banquet by Pausanias, and his son Alexander succeeded him, continuing his conquests.

appraisal.zh: 学界公认腓力二世是一位具有远见卓识的统治者，他凭借马其顿方阵与伙伴骑兵等军事创新及精明的外交联盟，把马其顿从边缘小国变为希腊世界的霸主，建立高效行政体系，促成希腊文化与马其顿传统的融合，为希腊化时代奠定基础；其成就虽常被亚历山大大帝的光芒掩盖，但没有他的改革与准备，东征无从谈起。也有研究者指出，他的统治建立在暴力与背叛之上，靠暗杀、欺骗和征服维持权力，损害了希腊城邦的独立，多妻多情导致家庭与政治不稳，扩张造成大量伤亡与文化破坏，对希腊实为缺乏文化认同与合法性的军事占领。
appraisal.en: Philip II is widely recognized as a visionary ruler who, through military innovations such as the Macedonian phalanx and Companion Cavalry and shrewd diplomacy and alliances, turned Macedon from a marginal kingdom into the dominant power of the Greek world, built an efficient administration, fused Greek culture with Macedonian traditions and laid the foundation for the Hellenistic era; his achievements are often overshadowed by Alexander the Great, yet without his reforms and preparations the eastern campaign would have been impossible. Some researchers note that his rule rested on violence and betrayal, maintained through assassination, deception and conquest, damaged the independence of Greek city-states, his multiple wives and mistresses strained family and political stability, and expansion caused heavy casualties and cultural destruction, amounting to a military occupation lacking cultural legitimacy in Greek eyes.

supporter.zh: 腓力二世被视为一位卓越的军事改革家和战略家，他成功地将马其顿从一个边缘小国转变为希腊世界的霸主。他的军事创新，包括马其顿方阵和伙伴骑兵，彻底改变了古代战争的面貌。腓力二世还建立了高效的行政体系，促进了希腊文化与马其顿传统的融合，为希腊化时代的到来奠定了基础。他的远见卓识和治国才能使他成为历史上最伟大的君主之一，他的遗产不仅体现在军事成就上，更体现在他创建的政治结构和制度上，这些制度被亚历山大大帝继承并进一步发扬光大。
supporter.en: Philip II is regarded as an exceptional military reformer and strategist who successfully transformed Macedon from a marginal kingdom into the dominant power in the Greek world. His military innovations, including the Macedonian phalanx and Companion Cavalry, revolutionized ancient warfare. Philip also established an efficient administrative system and promoted the fusion of Greek culture with Macedonian traditions, laying the foundation for the Hellenistic era. His vision and statesmanship make him one of history's greatest rulers, whose legacy extends beyond military achievements to the political structures and systems he created, which were inherited and further developed by Alexander the Great.

critic.zh: 批评者认为腓力二世是一位冷酷无情的独裁者，他的统治建立在暴力和背叛之上。他通过暗杀、欺骗和军事征服来维持权力，对希腊城邦的独立造成了不可挽回的损害。腓力二世的个人生活也充满争议，他有多位妻子和情妇，导致家庭关系紧张，甚至影响了政治稳定。他的军事扩张虽然强大，但也导致了无数生命的损失和文化的破坏。此外，批评者指出腓力二世虽然征服了希腊，却未能真正赢得希腊人的尊重和忠诚，他的统治本质上是一种军事占领，缺乏文化认同和合法性。
critic.en: Critics view Philip II as a ruthless dictator whose rule was built on violence and betrayal. He maintained power through assassination, deception, and military conquest, causing irreparable damage to the independence of Greek city-states. Philip's personal life was also controversial, with multiple wives and mistresses leading to strained family relations that affected political stability. His military expansion, though powerful, resulted in countless deaths and cultural destruction. Furthermore, critics note that while Philip conquered Greece, he never truly earned the respect and loyalty of the Greek people; his rule was essentially a military occupation lacking cultural legitimacy and genuine acceptance.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，腓力二世被公认为一位具有远见卓识的统治者，他的军事和政治改革深刻改变了地中海世界的格局。他不仅是一位军事天才，也是一位精明的政治家，善于利用外交手段和联盟策略来实现目标。腓力二世统治时期的马其顿成为希腊文化与马其顿传统的融合之地，为后来的希腊化时代奠定了基础。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为亚历山大大帝的伟大先驱，虽然他的成就有时被儿子的光芒所掩盖，但历史学家普遍认为没有腓力二世的改革和准备，亚历山大的东征是不可能成功的。腓力二世的一生展现了古代政治军事领袖的复杂性，既有辉煌的成就，也有争议的方面。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Philip II is widely recognized as a visionary ruler whose military and political reforms profoundly reshaped the Mediterranean world. He was not only a military genius but also a shrewd politician who skillfully used diplomacy and alliance strategies to achieve his goals. Macedon during Philip's reign became a fusion of Greek culture and Macedonian traditions, laying the foundation for the subsequent Hellenistic era. In popular culture, he is often depicted as the great precursor to Alexander the Great, and while his achievements are sometimes overshadowed by his son's glory, historians generally agree that Alexander's eastern campaigns would have been impossible without Philip's reforms and preparations. Philip's life exemplifies the complexity of ancient political and military leaders, featuring both brilliant achievements and controversial aspects.

self.zh: 一个国家不需要很多好公民，只需要足够的好公民。
self.en: A state does not need many good citizens, but only enough good citizens.
